lines.369680623782670336: I’m glad you’ve gotten this far, detective. Honestly, I was beginning to worry you wouldn't make it.
lines.369680623782670337: There was no other way. I don't have a choice.
lines.369680623786864640: Alice was my world. A bright shining star on a black night sky.
lines.369680623786864641: Now all that’s left for us is to rot until the end of time.
lines.369680623786864642: Maybe you can’t bring Alice back to me, but killing Eddie is the next best thing.
lines.369680623786864643: I'm not sure how I feel about that.
lines.369680623795253248: I know you're not a killer, Walker. But to Eddie, you're an angel of mercy.
lines.369680623795253249: I’m glad it’ll be you. It’s just the way it was always supposed to be.
lines.369680623799447552: Put him out of his misery.
lines.369680623824613376: Look at her. Look at what he did to my sweet girl...
lines.369680623828807680: I'm sorry. You must have loved her very much.
lines.369680623828807681: Eddie is still alive. And you want to offer condolences?
lines.369680623828807682: Killing Eddie won’t bring her back.
lines.369680623828807683: You’d rather rot here in Silver Pines? You couldn’t do the one thing, the only thing, that would get you out here? You’re weak. Pathetic.
lines.369680623833001984: I’m not going to run your errands. You want him dead so much, why don’t you do it yourself?
lines.369680623833001985: It has to be you! You have to kill him!
lines.369680623833001986: I’m done here. Whatever your game is, I don’t want to have any part of it.
lines.369680623862362112: Go back, finish what you started.
lines.369680623883333632: It's not too late to do the right thing.
lines.369680623904305152: Where do you think you're going?
lines.369680623912693760: I'm leaving. I told you, I'm done with this.
lines.369680623912693761: There's nothing for you out there.
lines.369680623912693762: I can't let you go. You're staying here. With me.
lines.369680623912693763: I don't think so. You'll have to stop me.
lines.369680623963025408: Useless pile of shit...I hate you.
lines.369680624055300097: Thank you for calling. I've been expecting you.
lines.369680624055300098: I'm sorry? This is my first time calling here.
lines.369680624059494400: Your call didn't begin when you dialed the number on the phone. It began when you decided you had nowhere else to go.
lines.369680624059494402: "While you're asking that, something else is happening. But no rush. It's ""the kind of moment that lasts forever"", right?"
